briefdescription.para: Phase 4 Block 4.2 Unit Tests — Schema Context Edge Cases.

detaileddescription.para:
Tests validation behavior for schema edge cases including:
Null and empty schema contexts
Missing collection metadata
Type mismatch in field definitions
Large schema handling
Diagnostic hint presence in error context
All tests are self-contained using inline mock implementations. No external dependencies beyond GTest and aql/aql_error_types.h.
